normalized.prelim_summary: This 2016 Scion FR-S Release Series 2.0 is a rare manual example with desirable factory options and aftermarket suspension upgrades, but it carries a salvage/rebuilt title from a documented 2020 accident with moderate-to-severe damage. The seller provided a repair invoice and extensive Q&A, but no pre-repair photos, leaving some uncertainty about the full extent of damage. Buyers should weigh the attractive rarity and spec against the branded title and accident history.
